about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Full-stack by day: React and Java in production for the Inditex ecosystem. At night I build my own projects on my homelab.
about.description: Full-stack developer with 6+ years of experience. Frontend with React and TypeScript, backend with Java (Spring Boot) and Node.js: microservices with hexagonal architecture serving 10,000+ daily users. I care about clean code and things done properly.
about.frontendDesc: Modern interfaces with React, Vue and TypeScript. I focus on making them fast, clear and easy to maintain.
about.backendDesc: Microservices with Java (Spring Boot) and APIs with Node.js. Hexagonal architecture, BFF, MongoDB and Redis in production.
about.fullstackDesc: When needed, I work across the full stack. I have built complete projects from scratch, server included.
about.philosophyText: I prefer simple code that works well over something complex nobody understands. And if it can look good on top of working, even better.
about.ctaText: I am available for projects. If you have something in mind, reach out.

featuredProjects.label: PROJECTS
featuredProjects.title: What I've built
featuredProjects.subtitle: A selection of personal and professional projects that showcase how I work.
featuredProjects.ironlogDesc: Mobile app to create routines, log workouts and track your progress. React Native + Expo, with data stored locally (AsyncStorage). I use it daily, installed as an APK.
featuredProjects.porraDesc: World Cup prediction game to compete with friends: guess the scores and climb your group's leaderboard. JavaScript + Supabase, deployed on Vercel.
featuredProjects.portfolioDesc: My personal portfolio with Next.js, TypeScript and Framer Motion, with a custom Node.js/Express REST API and MongoDB Atlas powering the Travels page live. Bilingual, with CI/CD on every push.
featuredProjects.comprasDesc: Real-time shared shopping list: React Native + Expo, Node.js backend with Socket.io and MongoDB Atlas. Deployed on my home NAS with Docker, Nginx, automatic SSL and CI/CD via GitHub Actions. In real daily use.
featuredProjects.showcaseDesc: A reusable template for local-business websites: services landing, online shop with cart, appointment booking and an admin panel behind login. Next.js + TypeScript, bilingual (next-intl) and SEO-optimized. A clean base I adapt to each client's brand and content.
featuredProjects.umedicinaesteticaDesc: Website and management system for Ū Medicina Estética, a newly opened clinic in Santander. On top of the bilingual public site (medical units, treatments, team, blog, contact) it ships its own back office for scheduling, appointments, content and patient records: the clinic edits it themselves, with no WordPress and no plugins to keep updated. Next.js, Postgres with Drizzle, Clerk and automated reminders via cron.
featuredProjects.bodaWebDesc: A wedding website for a friend and her partner: details of the day, per-guest RSVP with allergies, a message and a bus leg, and a private back office where they change copy, colours and guests themselves. React + Vite with Supabase: guest data isn't publicly readable, and the message notification comes from an Edge Function with Brevo.
featuredProjects.uskinstoreDesc: A Shopify store for Ū Medicina Estética: cosmetics and dermo-pharmacy where part of the catalogue can only be bought with a code the clinic hands out, because selective-distribution brands don't allow indiscriminate online sale. Custom Liquid theme, a purpose-built gating app (App Proxy with HMAC, Shopify Functions and scrypt-hashed codes) and a catalogue loaded by Python scripts.

cookieConsent.title: Cookies
cookieConsent.body: I use first-party cookies that the site needs to work and, only if you allow it, analytics and session replay to understand what breaks and what gets read. You can reject everything and keep browsing just the same.
cookieConsent.necessaryDesc: Language, theme and your own cookie decision. The site does not work without them, so they need no consent.
cookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Visits and most-read pages. Sets Google cookies and may involve a transfer to the USA.
cookieConsent.monitoringDesc: Reconstructs your browsing when an error fires so it can be reproduced. Plain error reporting works at all times and stores no identifying data.
